DELIVERY PERIED: Materials are to be delivered at consignee store on Freight Paid basis within 210 d ays from the issuance of Purchase Order. The date of delivery to be reckoned as the date of receipt of the material at site b y the consignee. 4. TERMS OF PAYMENT 100% payment alongwith full GST at actual, subject to the limit as quoted for suc h item, will normally be made by the purchaser to the Vendor through NEFT/RTG S within 15 working days from the date of receipt of material at site and after ins pection & acceptance thereof or from date of receipt of invoice whichever is later . Notes: a) The invoice /bill in triplicate, is to be raised in the name of the consignee and s ubmitted to consignee with copies of receipted challan, guarantee certificate etc for initiating payment action. b) No advance payment will be made against the works/service/Supply contract. d) The payment will be made to the supplier through NEFT/RTGS within 10 days f rom the date of receipt of materials at DVC store and after satisfactory inspectio n & acceptance thereof by our concerned Engineer. 5. SECURITY DEPOSIT-CUM-PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE: Security deposit shall be recovered as Pro-rata deduction @ 3% from the RA bills, and it will be released after Performance Guarantee period. 6. LIQUIDATED DAMAGE CLAUSE- As per General Terms & Conditions of GeM. The Vendor shall agree to replace any material, which has been proved defective or fails to conform to the desired specifications free of cost to the Purcha ser within the Guarantee/Warranty Period. The guarantee period for such replaced part shall be the same as that of equipment / materials specified earlier. 10. PRE-DISPATCH INSPECTION/ INSPECTION: Goods supplied will always be subject to DVC inspection on arrival at the destinati on-consignee address. Inspection will be done at DVC store after delivery.
